affinity.notes: Its construction is grotesquely physical—flesh, corpses, and debris—with no dominant elemental substance.

anatomy.notes: Numerous arms and bodies merge into a muddy central mass with uncertain locomotion.

archetype.notes: Spawner and siege role communicates the corpse-production sovereign duty.

counterplay.notes: The crowded mass does not clearly distinguish a vulnerable core, primary attack limb, or readable windup direction.

finish.notes: Dense repeated detail weakens hierarchy around the head and primary limbs.

framing.notes: Broad landscape crop suits its intended immense scale.

identity.notes: Multi-limbed corpse mound identifies the Plague Lord form.

tier.notes: Blind reviewer perceived T5; exact intended tier is T5.
